an3.40:7.1: The Ender: an epithet for Māra, who as repeated mortality keeps putting an end to things.
an3.40:7.2: Such (tādin): An adjective applied to the mind of one who has attained the goal. It indicates that the mind “is what it is”—indescribable but not subject to change or alteration.
an3.40:7.4: See also: MN 24; SN 51:15; AN 4:159; AN 4:245
